facts: Mono is a free and open - source project.
Mono is a project to create an Ecma standard - compliant .NET Framework - compatible software framework.
Mono includes a Common Language Runtime.
Mono was later acquired by Novell.
Mono is now being led by Xamarin.
The stated purpose of Mono is to be able to run Microsoft .NET applications cross - platform.
The stated purpose of Mono is to bring better development tools to Linux developers.
Mono can be run on many software systems.
The Mono project has been controversial within the open - source community.
Mono implements portions of .NET Framework that may be covered by Microsoft patents.
Standardized portions of .NET Framework are covered under Microsoft Open Specification Promise.
Other portions of .NET Framework are not covered under Microsoft Open Specification Promise.
An updated patent promise has been issued for the Mono project.
